about.title: About Voie Libre
about.intro: A route planner for road cycling, gravel and trail running. Free, without advertising, and open source.
about.privacy: Your saved routes stay on your device. To compute a route or search for a place, the app sends the points or the words concerned to the server. The relief (on by default) is read from Amazon's public terrain tiles and the aerial photos (optional) from the IGN: those servers see your address and the area you look at.
about.issues: Report a problem or suggest an idea

credits.map: Map: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), tiles by Protomaps.
credits.photos: Aerial photos: IGN (Licence Ouverte Etalab 2.0), when you ask for them.
credits.relief: Relief: terrain tiles from Mapzen and Amazon; elevations from SRTM (NASA, NGA).

about.support: Voie Libre is free and has no advertising. The server costs about 86 € a year before tax, and the domain name comes on top; the author pays both.

welcome.title: Welcome to Voie Libre
welcome.intro: Plan road, gravel and trail routes on a map made for it.

route.title: Plan a route
route.text: Click the map to place a start, then a destination. Add stops anywhere, drag the markers, pick the profile and read the elevation.

loop.title: Make a loop
loop.text: Place just a start and press “Make a loop”: choose a distance or a duration, a climb and a direction, and get a round trip from there.

welcome.free: Voie Libre is free, without advertising, and your routes stay on your device. The author pays for the server: if the app is useful to you, you can help.
